name: zero-day
about: §4R L2: a fold with a zero — one campaign spent nothing and showed nowhere, another spent with no lead, so neither has a cost per lead.

output.headline: 2 campaigns ran on November 3, 2026, spending $42.10 across 2,300 impressions and 19 clicks, with no leads generated.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet served no impressions and spent $0.00 — it did not deliver at all on November 3, 2026. Dedicated night runs carried the full day: $42.10 spent, 2,300 impressions, 19 clicks, and a 0.8% click rate, but no leads from either campaign.
No leads came in on the day, so there is no cost per lead to report.
The 2026-09-21 cohort (38 leads) has a contacted rate of 86.8%, a converted rate of 44.7%, an applied rate of 26.3%, a hired rate of 10.5%, and 8 leads lost after conversion.
The 2026-09-28 cohort (40 leads) shows a contacted rate of 90.0%, a converted rate of 50.0%, an applied rate of 30.0%, a hired rate of 12.5%, and 9 leads lost after conversion.
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads — 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied, and 1 lost after conversion — but it is too young to judge by rates.
November 2026 is 28 days from close; $42.10 has been spent so far, all on Meta.
